title: Tech Note: New Operators and Method Editor

historical_commentary.text: This note documents a narrow tokenization edge case in the V6 Method editor (a symbol/operator ambiguity around the interprocess variable prefix) that only matters to anyone still hand-editing legacy V3/V6-era binary-structure method code; the underlying V6 Method editor and its tokenizer were themselves superseded long ago by later-generation code editors. The specific workaround is of historical interest only for modern development.
related_updates: 4D V6's Method editor was replaced by vastly improved code editors in later 4D versions (with syntax coloring, live syntax checking, and eventually a modern IDE)
Project Mode (introduced in v17, 2018) uses plain-text .4dm method files edited outside the old binary-structure tokenizer entirely, making this class of tokenization ambiguity obsolete
